author: builder4

source_snapshot.description: Foreman-supplied pinned Flight TypeScript source archive

decision_basis.include: An opaque platform object or provider-owned identity that the SDK retains and passes without portable code interpreting the platform representation.
decision_basis.exclude: SDK-defined descriptive/value records, language/IR vocabulary, and GPU resources created and consumed wholly inside a rendering backend.
decision_basis.required_rust_representation_if_approved: { provider: ProviderRef, handle: Arc<dyn Any + Send + Sync> }; Arc identity is platform-object identity
decision_basis.ownership_rule: Capability contracts remain with the feature that names their SDK types (D8); only the leaf host-vocabulary types move to flight-hostcapability.
coverage_method: Enumerated every one of the 1,073 files in packages/types/src.

Scanned the complete declaration surface for host/capability contracts, external platform type identifiers, unknown/object seams, handle/subscription declarations, and comments that declare host/provider/native identity.

Read each candidate definition and its capability contract, then traced non-test TypeScript consumers/providers across the pinned packages tree and corresponding Rust definitions/consumers across repo/crates.
Classified backend-created WebGL/WebGPU resources and SDK-defined descriptive records separately so token matches are not treated as host-vocabulary conclusions.
